name: Marine Conservation Action Fund
summary: Small grants for community-based ocean conservation projects led by local conservationists in low- and middle-income countries. Applicants send a short funding inquiry first and may then be invited to submit a full proposal.

geography.label: low- and middle-income countries around the globe

status.quote: Proposals are reviewed on a rolling basis and reviewers may include members of MCAF Staff and experts from the global MCAF community.

geography.quote: provides support for community-based projects spearheaded by local conservation leaders in low- and middle-income countries around the globe

access.quote: Once a funding inquiry is received, we will advise as to whether we would like to invite a full proposal.
